title: India's Factories Are Busy: Understanding the Latest Industrial Production Numbers
description: The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) measures how much India's factories, mines, and power plants are producing. The latest data for August 2026 showed in.

faq.q: What is the base year for IIP in India?
faq.a: The current base year for India's IIP is 2022-23. It was recently revised from 2011-12 and the new series was released on June 1, 2026.

faq.q: How often is IIP data released?
faq.a: The IIP data is released every month by the National Statistical Office (NSO), usually with a time lag of about six weeks after the reference month ends.

faq.q: Which sectors contribute most to the IIP?
faq.a: Manufacturing is the largest component, accounting for about 76.062% of the IIP's total weight. Mining and Electricity & Gas Supply are the other significant sectors.

Yes, IIP data can influence stock markets as it's a key indicator of economic activity and corporate performance. Strong IIP figures can lead to positive market sentiment, while weak figures might have the opposite effect.

faq.q: Is IIP a leading or lagging indicator?
faq.a: IIP is generally considered a coincident indicator, meaning it moves along with the overall economic cycle. It provides a real-time snapshot of industrial activity.
